title: Steering Column Lower-Shaft Collapse Check
introduction:
This check compares the installed lower steering-shaft lengths with the ranges in the drawing for your driving position. I treat the illustration like a tailor's measuring guide: the marked endpoints matter just as much as the reading.

Keep the steering system fully assembled. Choose the left-hand-drive or right-hand-drive drawing, measure each marked span and compare it with its own range. This page covers the dimensional check and its replacement decision; replacement work requires a separate procedure for the matching lower shaft.

items.name: Keep the steering system assembled
items.detail: Perform the check with the steering system fully assembled. Do not disconnect or loosen the shaft to obtain the measurements.

items.name: Use the matching drawing and a measuring tape
items.detail: Select the drawing for the vehicle's driving position. Use a measuring tape as illustrated, measuring along each indicated span between its marked boundaries. Read the units and ranges directly from that drawing.

items.name: Prevent an unexpected start
items.detail: disable remote start, if equipped, through the Central Display at Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup before inspecting around or underneath the vehicle. Otherwise remote starting may occur at any time and cause personal injury or death. Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from accidentally starting the engine; an accidental start during service may cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Protect eyes, ears and hands
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during vehicle service, and protective gloves when handling pointed or sharp-edged parts. Omitting this protection may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Check cooling fans before underhood access
items.detail: With the ignition OFF, inspect all cooling fans for damage, cracks or separation. Do not work under the hood with a damaged fan; replace a damaged fan with a new one before proceeding because it can separate during operation and cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Disable cooling fans before working nearby
items.detail: If reaching the shaft puts you near a cooling fan, disable the fans before working there. Fans may run even with the ignition off, and unexpected operation may cause personal injury. Obtain the applicable disabling instructions before using an access route that requires this precaution.

edits.text: With the steering system fully assembled, use the left-hand-drive illustration to measure both marked lengths of the lower shaft between the indicated boundaries. Compare each reading with its corresponding range in that illustration. If either length is outside its range, discard the lower shaft and install a new one. Do not attempt to repair the shaft.
edits.why: Both readings must fall within their own illustrated ranges to pass this dimensional check. An out-of-range reading requires replacement rather than an attempt to restore the shaft's length. Use the matching lower-shaft replacement procedure for that subsequent work.

edits.text: With the steering system fully assembled, use the right-hand-drive illustration to measure both marked lengths of the lower shaft between the indicated boundaries. Compare each reading with its corresponding range in that illustration. If either length is outside its range, discard the lower shaft and install a new one. Do not attempt to repair the shaft.
edits.why: The right-hand-drive drawing has its own measurement spans and ranges. Both readings must satisfy that drawing to pass this dimensional check. A failed reading leads to a new shaft, installed using the matching replacement procedure; passing this check establishes only that the measured lengths meet these limits.
